The implementation preserves Phase 2 movement verbs only: left/right and fixed-height single ground jump. It does not add double jump, dash, wall jump, attack, enemies, health/lives, checkpoints, moving platforms, slopes, save/load, settings, export, launch, external testing, QA review, Learning Cards, or owner review changes. The scene references existing tracked Phase 3E obstacle and goal marker PNG assets for prototype-only gameplay-readable visual reuse without editing game/assets/**; the collectible remains placeholder-only. Because Godot texture resources depend on generated local import cache, Codex ran godot --headless --path game --import before final smoke/runtime checks; game/.godot remains ignored and is not an artifact or evidence source. Samantha worker execution produced scoped changes but reported blocked because the worker sandbox could not write Godot HOME data and could not fetch AJV. Codex post-harness verification in the main environment passed the required schema, marker, existing-asset-reference, smoke, clean-output, and headless-runtime checks after import cache regeneration.
